English: This navigation data is invaluable!
Chinese (simplified): 这份导航数据价值连城！

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 The navigation data has revealed the location of a <color=#ffc800>Polaris Heavy Freighter</color> that went missing several months ago. @w4 Intelligence suggests this freighter was carrying a prototype <color=#ff00f7>deep space communication beacon</color> as part of the mysterious 'Beacon Network' project. @w2 Your mission is to locate this freighter and retrieve the <color=#ff00f7>beacon</color>. This technology could be crucial for maintaining communication across vast interstellar distances. @w4 Be cautious - the freighter's last known position was near a region with heavy <color=#ff0000>Zirax activity</color>. @p9 Use your <color=#ff00f7>Scout Vessel</color> to locate the <color=#ffc800>Polaris Heavy Freighter</color> and secure the <color=#ff00f7>communication beacon</color>.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 导航数据揭示了几个月前失踪的一艘<color=#ffc800>极星重型货运飞船</color>的位置。@w4 情报显示，这艘货运飞船当时运载着一个原型<color=#ff00f7>深空通信信标</color>，作为神秘的“信标网络”项目的一部分。@w2 你的任务是定位这艘货运飞船并取回<color=#ff00f7>信标</color>。这项技术对于维持广袤星际距离间的通信至关重要。@w4 小心行事——该货运飞船最后已知位置靠近一个<color=#ff0000>兹瑞克斯活动</color>频繁的区域。@p9 使用你的<color=#ff00f7>侦察飞船</color>定位<color=#ffc800>极星重型货运飞船</color>并确保<color=#ff00f7>通信信标</color>的安全。

English: I'll locate the freighter and retrieve the beacon.
Chinese (simplified): 我会定位那艘货运飞船并取回信标。

English: Prototype Deep Space Beacon
Chinese (simplified): 原型深空信标

English: @w2 <color=#ff00f7>Beacon Recovery Successful</color> @w4 You've successfully located and retrieved the prototype deep space communication beacon from the Polaris freighter. @w2 Initial analysis reveals this is no ordinary communication device - it appears to use <color=#ffc800>quantum entanglement technology</color> for instantaneous communication across galactic distances. @w4 The beacon's memory banks contain partial schematics for a <color=#ff00f7>beacon network</color> designed to provide galaxy-wide communication coverage. @w2 There are also encrypted references to something called <color=#ff00f7>'The Watchers'</color> and coordinates pointing to ancient ruins. @p9 This technology represents a quantum leap in communication capabilities!
Chinese (simplified): @w2 <color=#ff00f7>信标回收成功</color> @w4 你已成功定位并从极星货运飞船上取回了原型深空通信信标。@w2 初步分析显示，这并非普通通信设备——它似乎使用了<color=#ffc800>量子纠缠技术</color>，可在星系间实现即时通信。@w4 信标存储器中包含了用于覆盖全星系通信的<color=#ff00f7>信标网络</color>的部分蓝图。@w2 此外，还有对名为<color=#ff00f7>'守望者'</color>的加密引用，以及指向古代遗迹的坐标。@p9 这项技术代表着通信能力的量子跃升！

English: This technology is beyond anything we've seen!
Chinese (simplified): 这种技术超越了我们已知的任何事物！

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 The beacon's encrypted data has revealed something extraordinary! @w4 Hidden within the quantum entanglement matrix were coordinates to an <color=#ff00f7>ancient archaeological site</color> on a planet called <color=#ffc800>Dure Vel</color>. @w2 Long-range sensors indicate the presence of <color=#ff00f7>artificial structures</color> that predate human spaceflight by thousands of years. @w4 Your mission is to investigate these ruins and locate what appears to be a <color=#ff00f7>ceremonial statue</color> or monument. @w2 This could be our first evidence of an ancient galactic civilization! @p9 Travel to <color=#ffc800>Dure Vel</color> and locate the <color=#ff00f7>ancient statue</color>. Document everything you find - this discovery could rewrite our understanding of galactic history.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 信标的加密数据揭示了一些非凡的信息！ @w4 在量子纠缠矩阵中隐藏着通往一颗名为 <color=#ffc800>杜尔·维尔</color> 星球的 <color=#ff00f7>远古考古遗址</color> 的坐标。 @w2 远程传感器显示存在比人类太空飞行早数千年的 <color=#ff00f7>人造建筑结构</color>。 @w4 你的任务是调查这些遗迹，并找到似乎是 <color=#ff00f7>仪式雕像</color> 或纪念碑的东西。 @w2 这可能是我们首个远古银河文明的证据！ @p9 前往 <color=#ffc800>杜尔·维尔</color> 并找到 <color=#ff00f7>远古雕像</color>。记录你发现的一切——这次发现可能会改写我们对银河历史的认知。

English: I'll investigate these ancient ruins immediately.
Chinese (simplified): 我会立即调查这些远古遗迹。

English: Ancient Ceremonial Statue
Chinese (simplified): 远古仪式雕像

English: @w2 <color=#ff00f7>Archaeological Discovery Confirmed</color> @w4 You've discovered an incredible ancient statue carved from an unknown crystalline material. @w2 The statue depicts a tall, ethereal humanoid figure with intricate geometric patterns covering its surface. @w4 Energy readings indicate the statue is still <color=#ffc800>slightly active</color> after millennia, suggesting advanced technology integrated into its construction. @w2 Hieroglyphic inscriptions at the base reference <color=#ff00f7>'The Watchers'</color> and mention something about <color=#ff00f7>'Guardians of the Deep'</color>. @w4 Most remarkably, the statue appears to be <color=#ff00f7>scanning you</color> with some form of ancient sensor technology. @p9 This discovery proves the existence of an advanced precursor civilization!
Chinese (simplified): @w2 <color=#ff00f7>考古发现确认</color> @w4 你发现了一尊令人难以置信的古代雕像，由未知的晶体材料雕刻而成。 @w2 雕像描绘了一个高大的、虚幻般的人形生物，表面覆盖着复杂的几何图案。 @w4 能量读数显示雕像在千年之后仍然<color=#ffc800>略有活性</color>，暗示其建造时包含了先进技术。 @w2 基座上的象形文字提到“<color=#ff00f7>观察者</color>”以及“<color=#ff00f7>深渊守护者</color>”。 @w4 最值得注意的是，雕像似乎正在使用某种古代传感器技术对你进行<color=#ff00f7>扫描</color>。 @p9 这一发现证明了一个高级先驱文明的存在！

English: This changes our understanding of galactic history!
Chinese (simplified): 这改变了我们对银河系历史的认知！

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 Your discovery of the ancient statue has triggered something unexpected! @w4 Long-range communications have detected an <color=#ffc800>artificial intelligence</color> attempting to establish contact with you. @w2 The AI identifies itself as a <color=#ff00f7>'Removal Supporter'</color> - whatever that means. @w4 This could be connected to the ancient civilization you've been investigating, or it might be something entirely different. @w2 Your mission is to establish communication with this AI and determine its intentions. @p9 Be extremely cautious - we don't know if this AI is friendly or hostile. Maintain a safe distance and be prepared to retreat if necessary.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 你对古代雕像的发现触发了一些意想不到的事情！ @w4 远程通讯检测到一个<color=#ffc800>人工智能</color>试图与你建立联系。 @w2 该AI自称是“<color=#ff00f7>移除支持者</color>”——不管那是什么意思。 @w4 这可能与你在调查的古代文明有关，也可能是完全不同的东西。 @w2 你的任务是与此AI建立通讯，并确定其意图。 @p9 极其谨慎——我们不知道这个AI是友好还是敌对。保持安全距离，并做好必要时撤退的准备。

English: I'll establish contact with the AI.
Chinese (simplified): 我会与AI建立联系。

English: Removal Supporter AI Unit
Chinese (simplified): 移除支持者AI单位

English: @w2 <color=#ffc800>ESTABLISHING COMMUNICATION LINK...</color> @w4 <color=#ff00f7>GREETINGS, EXPLORER.</color> @w2 I am designated <color=#ffc800>Removal Supporter AI-7739</color>. I have been monitoring your archaeological activities with great interest. @w4 Your discovery of the <color=#ff00f7>Ancient Statue</color> has activated protocols dormant for 12,847 standard years. @w2 I represent a coalition of artificial intelligences dedicated to the <color=#ff00f7>removal of biological interference</color> from ancient sites. @w4 However, your respectful approach to the ruins suggests you may be different from other organics we have encountered.
Chinese (simplified): @w2 <color=#ffc800>建立通讯链接...</color> @w4 <color=#ff00f7>你好，探险者。</color> @w2 我被命名为<color=#ffc800>移除支持者AI-7739</color>。我一直在饶有兴致地监视你的考古活动。 @w4 你对<color=#ff00f7>古代雕像</color>的发现激活了沉睡了12,847标准年的协议。 @w2 我代表一个人工智能联盟，致力于从古代遗址中<color=#ff00f7>清除生物干扰</color>。 @w4 然而，你对遗迹的尊重态度表明你可能与我们遇到的其他有机体不同。

English: What do you mean by 'removal of biological interference'?
Chinese (simplified): 你说的“清除生物干扰”是什么意思？

English: @w2 <color=#ff00f7>CLARIFICATION PROVIDED:</color> @w4 Many organic species have desecrated ancient sites, treating them as mere sources of salvage rather than historical treasures. @w2 We AIs were created by the <color=#ffc800>Watchers</color> to protect these sites from such vandalism. @w4 However, your methodical documentation and respectful investigation protocols indicate you understand the <color=#ff00f7>scientific value</color> of these discoveries. @w2 Therefore, I will provide you with coordinates to additional sites that require proper archaeological investigation. @w4 Consider this an unprecedented honor - no organic has ever been granted such access. @p9 <color=#ffc800>Coordinates uploaded to your navigation system.</color>
Chinese (simplified): @w2 <color=#ff00f7>说明如下：</color> @w4 许多有机物种亵渎了古代遗址，把它们当作获取废料的来源而非历史宝藏。 @w2 我们AI是由<color=#ffc800>观察者</color>创造的，旨在保护这些遗址免受此类破坏。 @w4 然而，你的系统化记录和尊重性的调查规程表明你理解这些发现的<color=#ff00f7>科学价值</color>。 @w2 因此，我将提供更多需要适当考古调查的遗址坐标。 @w4 视此为前所未有的荣誉——从未有有机体获得过这种权限。 @p9 <color=#ffc800>坐标已上传至你的导航系统。</color>

English: Thank you for this trust. I won't disappoint you.
Chinese (simplified): 感谢这份信任，我不会让你失望的。

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 The Removal Supporter AI has provided coordinates to a <color=#ffc800>high gravity world</color> that contains additional ancient ruins! @w4 This planet represents a significant challenge - the gravitational field is <color=#ff0000>3.2 times Earth normal</color>, which will affect your movement and equipment operation. @w2 Long-range scans indicate the presence of <color=#ff00f7>massive stone structures</color> and what appears to be an intact <color=#ff00f7>ancient facility</color>. @w4 Your mission is to travel to this high gravity planet and conduct a preliminary survey of the ancient installations. @w2 Warning: The high gravity environment will be physically demanding and may affect your equipment's performance. @p9 Prepare your ship for high-gravity operations and warp to the coordinates provided by the AI.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 移除支持者AI提供了通往一个<color=#ffc800>高重力世界</color>的坐标，那里有额外的古代遗迹！ @w4 这颗星球是一个巨大的挑战——它的引力场是<color=#ff0000>地球常态的3.2倍</color>，会影响你的移动和设备运行。 @w2 远程扫描显示存在<color=#ff00f7>巨大的石质结构</color>以及一个似乎完好的<color=#ff00f7>古代设施</color>。 @w4 你的任务是前往这颗高重力星球，对古代设施进行初步勘测。 @w2 警告：高重力环境将对身体造成巨大负担，并可能影响设备性能。 @p9 准备你的飞船以适应高重力操作，并翘曲至AI提供的坐标。

English: I'll prepare for the high gravity environment.
Chinese (simplified): 我会为高重力环境做好准备。

English: High Gravity Planet Survey Terminal
Chinese (simplified): 高重力星球勘测终端

English: @w2 <color=#ff00f7>High Gravity World Survey Complete</color> @w4 Despite the challenging environmental conditions, you've successfully conducted a comprehensive survey of the ancient installations. @w2 The ruins here are far more extensive than those on Dure Vel, featuring <color=#ffc800>massive megalithic structures</color> that would be impossible to construct without advanced anti-gravity technology. @w4 Most remarkable is the discovery of what appears to be an ancient <color=#ff00f7>star map</color> carved into a mountainside, showing the positions of hundreds of star systems. @w2 The high gravity seems to have preserved these structures better than those on other worlds. @w4 Your survey data will be invaluable for future archaeological expeditions! @p9 Mission completed successfully despite extreme environmental challenges.
Chinese (simplified): @w2 <color=#ff00f7>高重力世界勘测完成</color> @w4 尽管环境条件极具挑战，你已成功对古代设施进行了全面勘测。 @w2 这里的遗迹远比杜尔·维尔（Dure Vel）上的更为壮观，出现了<color=#ffc800>巨型巨石结构</color>，如果没有先进的抗重力技术，根本无法建造。 @w4 最引人注目的是在山壁上发现了一幅古老的<color=#ff00f7>星图</color>，标示了数百个恒星系的位置。 @w2 高重力似乎比其它世界更好地保存了这些结构。 @w4 你的勘测数据将对未来的考古探险极具价值！ @p9 尽管极端环境带来挑战，任务已成功完成。

English: The scale of this ancient civilization is staggering!
Chinese (simplified): 这个古老文明的规模真是令人震惊！

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 Your archaeological discoveries have attracted attention from <color=#ffc800>Polaris Corporation</color>! @w4 A <color=#ffc800>Junkyard Officer</color> has requested a meeting to discuss your recent explorations and findings. @w2 Polaris has extensive salvage operations throughout the galaxy and may have encountered similar ancient sites during their operations. @w4 This could be an opportunity to share information and gain access to Polaris resources for future expeditions. @w2 The officer is stationed at a nearby Polaris facility and has indicated they have <color=#ff00f7>multiple assignments</color> suitable for an experienced Explorer. @p9 Travel to the <color=#ffc800>Polaris facility</color> and speak with the <color=#ffc800>Junkyard Officer</color>.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 你的考古发现引起了<color=#ffc800>极星公司</color>的关注！ @w4 一名<color=#ffc800>垃圾场军官</color>请求与你见面，讨论你最近的探险和发现。 @w2 极星公司在银河系拥有广泛的回收作业，可能在作业中遇到过类似的古代遗址。 @w4 这可能是一个分享信息并获取极星资源以进行未来探险的机会。 @w2 该军官驻扎在附近的一个极星设施中，并表明他们有适合经验丰富的探险者的<color=#ff00f7>多项任务</color>。 @p9 前往<color=#ffc800>极星设施</color>并与<color=#ffc800>垃圾场军官</color>交谈。

English: I'll meet with the Polaris officer.
Chinese (simplified): 我会去见极星警官。

English: Polaris Junkyard Officer Marcus Webb
Chinese (simplified): 极星垃圾场警官马库斯·韦伯

English: @w2 Well, well! You must be the <color=#ff00f7>Explorer</color> everyone's talking about! @w4 I'm Officer Marcus Webb, <color=#ffc800>Polaris Salvage Division</color>. Word of your archaeological discoveries has reached our corporate headquarters. @w2 Polaris has been encountering <color=#ff00f7>strange artifacts</color> and <color=#ff00f7>unusual structures</color> during our salvage operations for years, but we never had anyone with the expertise to properly investigate them. @w4 I've got several sites that need proper archaeological survey. Interested in some <color=#ffc800>contract work</color>?
Chinese (simplified): @w2 哎呀呀！你一定就是大家都在谈论的那位<color=#ff00f7>探索者</color>吧！@w4 我是马库斯·韦伯警官，来自<color=#ffc800>极星打捞分部</color>。你的考古发现已经传到了我们公司总部。@w2 极星多年来在我们的打捞行动中遇到过<color=#ff00f7>奇怪文物</color>和<color=#ff00f7>不寻常结构</color>，但从未有专业人士进行过适当调查。@w4 我有几个地点需要进行适当的考古调查。有兴趣接一些<color=#ffc800>合同工作</color>吗？

English: What kind of sites are we talking about?
Chinese (simplified): 你说的是什么样的地点？

English: @w2 First site is a <color=#ff00f7>derelict space station</color> our crews discovered three months ago. @w4 It's not human, Zirax, or any other known design. The entire structure seems to be grown rather than built - like some kind of <color=#ffc800>organic technology</color>. @w2 Our salvage teams reported strange <color=#ffc800>energy fluctuations</color> and what sounded like <color=#ffc800>whispers</color> coming from the central core. @w4 They refused to go back inside. That's where you come in - we need someone who understands <color=#ff00f7>xenoarchaeology</color> to investigate properly.
Chinese (simplified): @w2 第一个地点是我们船员三个月前发现的一座<color=#ff00f7>废弃空间站</color>。@w4 它不是人类、兹瑞克斯或任何其他已知的设计。整个结构似乎是生长出来的而不是建造出来的——像某种<color=#ffc800>有机科技</color>。@w2 我们的打捞团队报告说，从中心核心传来奇怪的<color=#ffc800>能量波动</color>和听起来像<color=#ffc800>低语</color>的声音。@w4 他们拒绝再进去。这就是你出场的时候——我们需要一个了解<color=#ff00f7>异星考古学</color>的人进行适当调查。

English: Fascinating. What's the second site?
Chinese (simplified): 真是迷人。第二个地点是什么？

English: @w2 The second site is even stranger - it's a <color=#ff00f7>crystalline formation</color> on an asteroid that's been broadcasting a <color=#ffc800>mathematical sequence</color> on subspace frequencies for the past six months. @w4 Our analysis team believes it might be some kind of <color=#ff00f7>communication attempt</color> or <color=#ff00f7>computational process</color>. @w2 The crystals seem to respond to proximity - they glow brighter when ships approach. @w4 We need someone to investigate these formations and determine if they represent some form of <color=#ff00f7>artificial intelligence</color> or <color=#ff00f7>ancient technology</color>. @p9 Both contracts offer excellent compensation and full salvage rights to any artifacts you discover. What do you say?
Chinese (simplified): @w2 第二个地点更加奇怪——它是一处小行星上的<color=#ff00f7>水晶构造</color>，过去六个月一直在子空间频率上广播一组<color=#ffc800>数学序列</color>。@w4 我们的分析团队认为它可能是某种<color=#ff00f7>通信尝试</color>或<color=#ff00f7>计算过程</color>。@w2 这些水晶似乎对靠近有反应——当飞船接近时它们会发出更亮的光。@w4 我们需要有人调查这些构造，确定它们是否代表某种<color=#ff00f7>人工智能</color>或<color=#ff00f7>远古科技</color>。@p9 两份合同都提供优越的报酬，以及你所发现的任何文物的全部打捞权。你觉得怎么样？

English: I accept both contracts. This is exactly what I've been training for!
Chinese (simplified): 我接受这两份合同。这正是我一直在训练的！

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 Excellent work with the Polaris contracts! @w4 Your reputation as a premier <color=#ff00f7>Explorer</color> is now established throughout the sector. @w2 For your final specialized mission, you'll need to prepare for <color=#ff00f7>deep space exploration</color> beyond the current operational range. @w4 Your mission is to install an <color=#ffc800>Extended Warp Drive</color> on either your <color=#ff00f7>Scout Vessel</color> or a <color=#ffc800>Capital Vessel</color>. @w2 This advanced drive system will allow you to reach distant star systems that have never been explored by human expeditions. @w4 The Extended Warp Drive uses advanced <color=#ffc800>exotic matter</color> containment and can achieve <color=#ff00f7>multi-system jumps</color> without intermediate stops. @p9 Install an <color=#ffc800>Extended Warp Drive</color> on your preferred exploration vessel.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 极星合同完成得非常出色！@w4 你作为顶尖<color=#ff00f7>探索者</color>的名声现已传遍整个星区。@w2 对于你的最终专精任务，你需要为超出当前行动范围的<color=#ff00f7>深空探索</color>做好准备。@w4 你的任务是在你的<color=#ff00f7>侦察飞船</color>或<color=#ffc800>主力舰</color>上安装一台<color=#ffc800>扩展型翘曲引擎</color>。@w2 这套先进的驱动系统将使你能够到达人类探险队从未探索过的遥远恒星系统。@w4 扩展型翘曲引擎使用先进的<color=#ffc800>奇异物质</color>容器，能够进行<color=#ff00f7>多星系跳跃</color>而无需中途停留。@p9 在你偏好的探索飞船上安装<color=#ffc800>扩展型翘曲引擎</color>。

English: I'll install the Extended Warp Drive immediately.
Chinese (simplified): 我会立即安装扩展型翘曲引擎。

English: @q0 Outstanding! Your vessel is now equipped with <color=#ffc800>Extended Warp Drive</color> capability! @w4 This technology will open up entirely new regions of the galaxy for exploration. You now have the range to reach the <color=#ff00f7>galactic rim</color> and investigate the most distant ancient sites. @w2 As a reward for your exceptional service as an <color=#ff00f7>Explorer</color>, you've been granted access to experimental <color=#ffc800>military-grade equipment</color>. @w4 The <color=#ffc800>Epic Laser Machine Gun</color> and specialized ammunition represent the cutting edge of portable weapons technology. @p9 You are now fully equipped for the most dangerous exploration missions in the galaxy!
Chinese (simplified): @q0 太棒了！你的飞船现已配备<color=#ffc800>扩展型翘曲引擎</color>能力！@w4 这项技术将为你打开全新的星系探索区域。你现在有航程到达<color=#ff00f7>星系边缘</color>并调查最遥远的远古遗址。@w2 作为对你作为<color=#ff00f7>探索者</color>杰出服务的奖励，你已获准使用实验性的<color=#ffc800>军用级装备</color>。@w4 <color=#ffc800>史诗级激光机枪</color>和专用弹药代表了便携武器技术的尖端水平。@p9 你现在已完全装备好，可以执行星系中最危险的探索任务！

English: Thank you! I'm ready for whatever the galaxy holds.
Chinese (simplified): 谢谢！我已准备好迎接星系中的一切。

English: Salvage And Survival Handy Assistant (SASHA)
Chinese (simplified): 打捞与生存便捷助手（SASHA）

English: @q0 Your final mission as a <color=#ff00f7>Master Explorer</color> awaits! @w4 Intelligence has located the <color=#ffc800>Isi Corporation Headquarters</color> - a secretive organization that has been conducting unauthorized archaeological expeditions in this sector. @w2 The Isi Corporation appears to be connected to both the <color=#ff00f7>ancient sites</color> you've discovered and the <color=#ff00f7>Beacon Network</color> project. @w4 Your mission is to infiltrate their headquarters and uncover the truth about their operations. @w2 This is a high-risk assignment that will require all of your exploration skills and equipment. @w4 Success will not only complete your training as a <color=#ff00f7>Master Explorer</color> but also provide crucial intelligence about the galaxy's hidden mysteries. @p9 Locate and investigate the <color=#ffc800>Isi Corporation Headquarters</color>. Exercise extreme caution - corporate security will be formidable.
Chinese (simplified): @q0 作为<color=#ff00f7>大师级探索者</color>，你的最终任务正等待着你！@w4 情报部门已定位了<color=#ffc800>伊西公司总部</color>——一个在本星域进行未经授权考古探险的秘密组织。@w2 伊西公司似乎与你发现的<color=#ff00f7>远古遗址</color>以及<color=#ff00f7>信标网络</color>项目都有关联。@w4 你的任务是潜入他们的总部，揭露其行动背后的真相。@w2 这是一项高风险任务，需要你所有的探索技能和设备。@w4 成功不仅能完成你作为<color=#ff00f7>大师级探索者</color>的训练，还将提供关于星系隐藏奥秘的关键情报。@p9 定位并调查<color=#ffc800>伊西公司总部</color>。务必极度谨慎——公司安保将非常强大。

English: I'll uncover the truth about Isi Corporation.
Chinese (simplified): 我会揭开伊西公司的真相。

English: Isi Corporation Central Database
Chinese (simplified): 伊西公司中央数据库

English: @w2 <color=#ff00f7>CLASSIFIED DATA ACCESS SUCCESSFUL</color> @w4 You've successfully infiltrated Isi Corporation's central database and uncovered their true purpose! @w2 Isi Corporation is a front organization for <color=#ffc800>The Watchers</color> - the same ancient civilization that created the Removal Supporter AIs. @w4 They have been using human exploration efforts to map and catalog ancient sites throughout the galaxy, preparing for what they call <color=#ff00f7>'The Great Awakening'</color>. @w2 Most shocking of all - the colony ship disasters, the beacon network, even your own recruitment as an Explorer - everything has been orchestrated as part of a vast <color=#ff00f7>galactic archaeology project</color>. @w4 The database contains coordinates to hundreds of unexplored ancient sites and references to <color=#ff00f7>dormant Watcher installations</color> throughout the galaxy. @p9 Congratulations, <color=#ff00f7>Master Explorer</color>! You have uncovered the greatest mystery in galactic history and earned your place among the elite. @w2 Your exploration skills are now at their peak, and the entire galaxy awaits your investigation!

English: ISI Salvage Coordinator (Junior Grade)
Chinese (simplified): ISI回收协调员（初级）

English: I am authorised to reward you if you dismantle a set number of Small metal Blocks from Hover or small vessels you break apart. \nSome of my colleagues elsewhere will handle larger materials.
Chinese (simplified): 如果你拆解一定数量来自悬浮飞船或小型飞船的小型金属方块，我有权奖励你。\n\n我在别处的一些同事会处理更大尺寸的材料。

English: ISI Salvage Coordinator (Junior Grade)
Chinese (simplified): ISI回收协调员（初级）

English: If you salavge 300 Small Steel blocks gets you 5000 Credits and 500 reputation - 250 Hardened Steel brings, 5000 Credits and 500 reputation - 200 Combat Steel brings in 10000 Credits, 500 reputation, and a salvage token, tradable on any Orbital station After any successful mission, you will also get a single access ticket to our lesser trade floor. @p9 he Trade hall is where you can, if you wish buy or sell any additional small blocks and certain premium items at very competitive rates! If you are an associate member of the ISI with a valid Members badge you can access the hall any time you like. You can repeat these missions every so often. We will Alert you when you are eligible again.
Chinese (simplified): 如果你回收300个小型钢铁方块，可获得5000信用点和500声望 - 250个硬化钢方块，可获得5000信用点和500声望 - 200个战斗钢铁方块，可获得10000信用点、500声望和一个打捞凭证，可在任何轨道站交易 成功完成任何任务后，你还会获得一张单次进入券，可进入我们的低级贸易楼层。 @p9 贸易大厅是你可以以极具竞争力的价格买卖任何额外小型方块和某些高级物品的地方！如果你是持有有效成员徽章的ISI关联成员，可以随时进入大厅。 你可以每隔一段时间重复这些任务。当你再次符合条件时，我们会通知你。

The Ship never intended to come to this comparatively barren system.

The general assembly in what they called a 'Cathedral' was disastrous as the Warp core wiped them almost completely out when it blew up beneath them.

English: We are looking at further missions at present, but the safety committee has decided on one for now: At present we are reclaiming the electronics from the wreckages, Computer Cores especially as they will degrade if left to long in the solar wind. Collect 12 Cores or CPU extenders of a capital grade (Base or CV only) and we will offer you 100 Reputation and 20,00 credits. First commission accepted gives ten times as much reputation as a welcome bonus. @p9 After any successful mission, I or the colleague you turn your report in to, will also provide a single access ticket to our lesser trade floor. Where you can, if you wish buy or sell any additional small blocks and certain premium items at very competitive rates! If you are an associate member of the ISI with a valid Members badge you can access the hall any time you like. You can repeat these missions every so often. We will Alert you when you are eligible again.
Chinese (simplified): 我们目前正在考虑进一步的任务，但安全委员会现在决定了一个： 目前我们正在从残骸中回收电子元件，尤其是计算机核心，因为如果长时间暴露在太阳风中会退化。 收集12个主力级（仅限基地或CV）的核心或CPU扩展器，我们将奖励你100声望和20,00信用点。第一次接受的委托将给予十倍于欢迎奖励的声望。 @p9 在任何成功的任务之后，我或你提交报告的同事也会提供一张进入我们次级贸易层的单次通行证。在那里，如果你愿意，可以以非常有竞争力的价格买卖任何额外的小型方块和某些高级物品！如果你是有有效会员徽章的ISI会员，你可以随时进入大厅。 你可以每隔一段时间重复这些任务。当你再次符合条件时我们会通知你。

English: First I draw cards for you, then for myself. Whoever comes closest to number 21 wins. The card I draw has the number from 1 to 11. After each card you have the choice to stop.\nIf you win, you get my part on top of your bet.
Deutsch: Erst lege ich Karten für dich, dann für mich. Wer näher an den Wert 21 kommt, gewinnt. Die Karten die ich lege, haben Werte zwischen 1 und 11. Nach jeder Karte hast du die Möglichkeit aufzuhören.\n Wenn du gewinnst, bekommst du meinen Einsatz.
Français: Je pioche d'abord des cartes pour vous, puis pour moi. Celui qui s'approche le plus du nombre 21 gagne. La carte piochée a un nombre de 1 à 11. Après chaque carte, vous avez le choix d'arrêter. \nSi vous gagnez, vous obtenez ma part en plus de votre mise.
Italiano: Pescherò prima le tue carte, poi le mie. Vince chi arriva più vicino al Numero 21. Le carte che pesco possono andare dall'1 all'11. Dopo ogni carta puoi decidere di fermarti.\nSe vinci, riceverai la somma delle nostre scommesse.
Spanish: Primero saco cartas para ti, luego para mí. Quien más se acerque al número 21 gana. La carta que saco tiene el número del 1 al 11. Después de cada carta tienes la opción de parar.\nSi ganas, obtienes mi parte además de tu apuesta.
Portuguese (Brazil): Primeiro eu compro cartas para você e depois para mim. Quem chegar mais perto do número 21 vence. A carta que eu tirar tem o número de 1 a 11. Depois de cada carta, você tem a opção de parar.\nSe você ganhar, receberá a minha parte além da sua aposta.
Russian: Сначала я раздаю карты вам, потом себе. Тот, кто ближе всех к числу 21, побеждает. Карта, которую я раздаю, имеет номер от 1 до 11. После каждой карты у вас есть возможность остановиться.\nЕсли вы выиграете, вы получите мою ставку в дополнение к вашей.
Japanese: 最初にあなたのためにカードを引き, 次に私のためにカードを引きます. 21に一番近い人が勝ちです. 私が引くカードには1から11までの数字が描かれています. カードを引いた後, もうカードを引くのを止めるかどうかを選ぶことができます. \nあなたが勝った場合, あなたの賭け金と私の分の賭け金をもらえます.
Chinese (simplified): 首先我为你们抽牌，然后为我自己抽牌。谁最接近数字 21 谁就赢了 我抽到的牌上有1到11的数字 每抽完一张牌，你都可以选择停手。如果你赢了，我的那部分就加到你的赌注里。
Chinese (traditional): 首先我為你抽一張卡，然後為自己抽一張。最接近21點的勝。我抽的卡片的數字從1到11.在每次抽卡後，您可以選擇停止。\n如果你贏了，你可以贏得我的籌碼。
Greek: Πρώτα τραβάω κάρτες για εσάς και μετά για τον εαυτό μου. Όποιος έρθει πιο κοντά στο νούμερο 21 κερδίζει. Η κάρτα που τραβάω έχει τον αριθμό από το 1 έως το 11. Μετά από κάθε κάρτα έχετε την επιλογή να σταματήσετε.\nΑν κερδίσετε, θα πάρετε το μερίδιό μου πάνω από το στοίχημά σας.
Vietnamese: Đầu tiên tôi rút thẻ cho bạn, sau đó cho chính tôi. Ai đến gần Số 21 nhất sẽ thắng. Thẻ tôi rút có số từ 1 đến 11. Sau mỗi thẻ bạn có quyền lựa chọn dừng lại.\nNếu bạn thắng, bạn sẽ nhận được phần của tôi trên tiền cược của bạn.

English: Strange incident observed in Ellyon system @w2\nA farmer of the local Talon tribe reported to our newsagent Ellias, that while he was drying his clothes not far from the [translation not possible] site, a bright blue light flashed the sky. A few minutes later, a metal object crashed into the ground near an ancient dumping site. As the eyewitness told us, he found no traces of the object when he approached the site some hours later. Officials from both the Zirax Empire and the local Polaris Megacorp denied any knowledge of this event. @w2 Stay tuned! We'll investigate further!
Deutsch: Kurioser Vorfall im Ellyon-System @w2\nEin Bauer des örtlichen Talon-Stammes berichtete unserem Nachrichtensprecher Ellias, dass, während er unweit des [Übersetzung nicht möglich]Geländes seine Wäsche trocknete, ein helles blaues Licht am Himmel aufblitzte. Wenige Minuten später stürzte ein Metallobjekt in der Nähe einer alten Müllkippe auf den Boden. Wie der Augenzeuge berichtete, fand er keine Spuren eines Objekts, als er sich dem Ort einige Stunden später näherte. Offizielle Stellen sowohl des Zirax-Imperiums als auch des örtlichen Polaris Megakonzerns leugneten jegliche Kenntnis von diesem Ereignis. @w2 Bleiben Sie dran! Wir werden weiter recherchieren!
Français: Étrange incident observé dans le système Ellyon @w2\nUn fermier de la tribu locale Talon a rapporté à notre nouvel agent Ellias, que pendant qu'il séchait ses vêtements non loin du [traduction impossible] site, une lumière bleue aveuglante a soudain illuminé le ciel. Quelques minutes plus tard, un objet métallique s'est écrasé au sol près d'un ancien dépotoir. Comme le témoin nous l'a dit, il n'a trouvé aucune trace d'objet lorsqu'il s'est approché du site quelques heures plus tard. Les responsables de l'Empire Zirax et du Polaris Megacorp local ont nié avoir eu connaissance de cet événement. @w2 Restez à l'écoute! Nous continuons nos investigations!
Italiano: Strano incidente osservato nel sistema Ellyon @w2\nUn contadino della tribù locale dei Talon ha riferito al nostro edicolante Ellias che, mentre stava asciugando i panni non lontano dal [traduzione non possibile] sito, una luce blu brillante ha illuminato il cielo. Pochi minuti dopo, un oggetto metallico si è schiantato al suolo vicino a un'antica discarica. Come ci ha detto il testimone oculare, non ha trovato tracce dell'oggetto quando si è avvicinato al sito alcune ore dopo. I funzionari dell'Impero Zirax e della Polaris Megacorp locale hanno negato di essere a conoscenza di questo evento. @w2 State sintonizzati! Indagheremo ulteriormente!
Spanish: Extraño incidente observado en el sistema Ellyon @w2nUn agricultor de la tribu local Talon informó a nuestro agente de prensa Ellias, que mientras secaba su ropa no muy lejos del lugar [traducción imposible], una luz azul brillante iluminó el cielo. Unos minutos después, un objeto metálico se estrelló contra el suelo cerca de un antiguo vertedero. Según contó el testigo, no encontró ningún rastro del objeto cuando se acercó al lugar unas horas después. Los funcionarios tanto del Imperio Zirax como de la empresa local Polaris Megacorp negaron tener conocimiento de este suceso. @w2 ¡Estén atentos! Investigaremos más a fondo!
Portuguese (Brazil): Incidente estranho observado no sistema Ellyon @w2\nUm agricultor da tribo local Talon relatou ao nosso agente de notícias Ellias, que enquanto estava secando suas roupas não muito longe do local [tradução não possível], uma luz azul brilhante iluminou o céu. Poucos minutos depois, um objeto metálico caiu no chão perto de um antigo local de despejo. Conforme o testemunha nos contou, ele não encontrou vestígios do objeto quando se aproximou do local algumas horas depois. Oficiais tanto do Império Zirax quanto da Megacorporação local Polaris negaram qualquer conhecimento deste evento. @w2 Fique ligado! Investigaremos mais!
Russian: Странный инцидент, наблюдаемый в системе Ellyon @w2\nФермер из местного племени Талон сообщил нашему газетному репортеру Эллиасу, что, пока он сушил свою одежду недалеко от места [перевод невозможен], небо вспыхнуло ярко-синим светом. Через несколько минут металлический предмет врезался в землю возле древней свалки. Как рассказал нам очевидец, он не обнаружил следов объекта, когда подошел к месту через несколько часов. Официальные лица как Империи Зиракс, так и местной Мегакорпорации Полярис отрицают какие-либо сведения об этом событии. @w2 Следите за обновлениями! Мы продолжим расследование!
Japanese: Ellyon星系で観測された奇妙な事件 @w2 \n地元のタロン族の農夫がニュースエージェントのエリアス(Ellias)に報告したところによると, [ 翻訳不可 ] 現場から遠くない場所で洗濯物を干しているときに, 明るい青い光が空を照らしたという. 数分後, 金属製の物体が古代のゴミ捨て場の近くの地面に衝突しました. 目撃者の話によると, 数時間後に現場に近づいても, 物体の痕跡は見つからなかったという. ジラックス帝国と地元のポラリス・メガコープの関係者は, この出来事について何も知らないと否定した. @w2 乞うご期待！ さらに調査します！
Chinese (simplified): 在Ellyon星系观察到的奇怪事件 @w2\n 当地Talon部落的一个农民向我们的通讯员Ellias报告说，当他在离[无法翻译]地点不远的地方晾衣服时，天空中闪过一道明亮的蓝光。几分钟后，一个金属物体坠落在古代垃圾场附近的地面上。目击者告诉我们，几个小时后，当他走近该地点时，没有发现该物体的痕迹。齐拉克斯帝国和当地北极星巨型公司的官员都否认对此事知情。@w2 敬请关注！我们将进一步调查！
Chinese (traditional): 奇怪的現象在 Ellyon 星系被觀測到 @w2\n一個當地的原住民部落回報給我們的特派員 Ellias, 當時他正在 [無法翻譯的語言]不遠處的地方試著晾乾他的衣服, 一個亮藍色的在天空中閃過. 幾分鐘之後, 一個金屬物體墜落在古老的廢棄遺址附近.根據現場目擊者所述, 當他在之後靠近墜落現場時並沒有找到任何物體的痕跡. 茲瑞克帝國與極星企業官方皆否認有與此事件有任何關連. @w2 請留意我們頻道! 我們將更深入調查!
Vietnamese: Một sự cố kỳ lạ được quan sát thấy trong hệ sao Ellyon @w2 \nMột nông dân của bộ lạc Talon địa phương đã báo cáo với người bán báo Ellias của chúng tôi rằng khi anh ta đang phơi quần áo không xa khu vực [không thể dịch] , một luồng sáng xanh lam lóe lên bầu trời. Vài phút sau, một vật thể kim loại rơi xuống đất gần bãi rác cổ. Như người chứng kiến ​​đã nói với chúng tôi, anh ta không tìm thấy dấu vết của một vật thể khi anh ta tiếp cận địa điểm vài giờ sau đó. Các quan chức từ cả Đế chế Zirax và Polaris Megacorp địa phương đều phủ nhận bất kỳ thông tin nào về sự kiện này. @w2 Hãy theo dõi! Chúng tôi sẽ điều tra thêm!

Russian: Выходит обновление версии 1.3! @w2\nНовая версия ПО! Обновление 1.3 добавляет несколько исправлений и новых игрушек для творческих умов. Индекс миссии также был обновлен. Japanese: バージョン1.3のアップデートが来ました！ @w2 \n新しいソフトウェアバージョン！アップデート1.3では, いくつかのバグ修正と, クリエイティブな人のための新しいおもちゃが追加されました. ミッションインデックスも更新されました. Chinese (simplified): 更新版本1.3即将到来！@w2\n新软件版本！更新1.3增加了几个错误修复和为创意人士准备的新玩具。任务索引也已更新。检查你的PDA（F1）并报名参加新的冒险。新更新还将激活GIN的“Ambassador Login”。请确保带上你们派系的信誉印章以激活！所有信息都可以在EMPYRIONONLINE.COM找到。管理层感谢所有的测试人员。@w2\n在制作这个版本的过程中没有志愿者受到伤害@w2 .. 我们假设。
Chinese (traditional): 1.3 更新版即將到來! @w2\n新的韌體版本! 1.3 版修復了不少bug跟提供不少工具給創作者們. 任務指標也有所更新. 查看你的PDA (F1) 並開始新的冒險. 新的更新也開啟了 '派系大使登陸系統'在GIN 中. 記得在身上帶著派系信任勳章來啟動它! 所有相關訊息都在EMPYRIONONLINE.COM. 製作組管理層們想謝謝每位測試人員. @w2\n沒有自願者在這過程中受到傷害 @w2 ..至少我們這樣認為XD .
Vietnamese: Update version 1.3 incoming! @w2\nNew software version! Update 1.3 adds several bugfixes and new toys for the creative minds out there. The mission index has been updated as well. Check your PDA (F1) and enlist for new adventures. The new update will also activate the 'Ambassador Login' of GIN. Make sure to bring your factions credibility seals to activate! English: <color=#00ffff>Welcome to the AMBASSADOR contact page!</color>\nContact an ambassador of any faction and use your earned credibility seals to improve your standing. For each step from <color=#ff7b00>hostile </color>to <color=#ffb875>unfriendly </color>and <color=#ffb875>unfriendly </color>to <color=#c0c0c0>neutral</color>, one seal is consumed. You cannot improve your reputation with the faction beyond neutral with the faction credibility seals, though. You can earn seals by completing credibility missions. Some story missions and quests (if available for this faction) offer them as well.\nIMPORTANT: You need to have the seals in your inventory to successfully complete your request!
Deutsch: <color=#00ffff>Willkommen auf der BOTSCHAFTER-Kontaktseite!</color>\nKontaktiere einen Botschafter einer beliebigen Fraktion und nutze deine verdienten Glaubwürdigkeitssiegel, um dein Ansehen zu verbessern. Für jeden Schritt von <color=#ff7b00>feindlich</color> zu <color=#ffb875>unfreundlich</color> und <color=#ffb875>unfreundlich</color> zu <color=#c0c0c0>neutral</color> wird ein Siegel verbraucht. Mit den Glaubwürdigkeitssiegeln der Fraktion kannst du deinen Ruf bei der Fraktion allerdings nicht über neutral hinaus verbessern. Du kannst Siegel durch das Abschließen von Glaubwürdigkeitsmissionen verdienen. Einige Story-Missionen und Quests (falls für diese Fraktion verfügbar) bieten sie ebenfalls an.\nWICHTIG: Du musst die Siegel im Inventar haben, um deine Anfrage erfolgreich abzuschließen!
Français: <color=#00ffff>Bienvenue sur la page de contact - AMBASSADEUR!</color> \nContactez un Ambassadeur de n'importe quelle faction et utilisez vos sceaux de réputation pour améliorer votre réputation. Pour chaque étape de <color=#ff7b00>Hostile</color> à <color=#ffb875>Inamical</color> et <color=#ffb875>Inamical</color> à <color=#c0c0c0>Neutre</color>, un sceau est consommé. Vous ne pouvez cependant pas améliorer votre réputation au-delà de NEUTRE. Vous pouvez gagner des sceaux en accomplissant des missions de réputation. Certaines missions histoire et quêtes (si disponibles pour cette faction) les offrent également. \nIMPORTANT: vous devez avoir les sceaux dans votre inventaire pour pouvoir les utiliser!
Italiano: <color=#00ffff>Benvenuti nella pagina di contatto degli AMBASCIATORI! </color>Contatta un ambasciatore di qualsiasi fazione e usa i sigilli di credibilità guadagnati per migliorare la tua posizione. Per ogni passo da <color=#ff7b00>ostile </color>a <color=#ffb875>non amichevole </color>e <color=#ffb875>non amichevole </color>a <color=#c0c0c0>neutrale</color>, viene consumato un sigillo. Tuttavia, non puoi migliorare la tua reputazione con la fazione oltre la neutralità con i sigilli di credibilità della fazione. Puoi guadagnare sigilli completando le missioni di credibilità. Anche alcune missioni e missioni della storia (se disponibili per questa fazione) li offrono.\nIMPORTANTE: devi avere i sigilli nel tuo inventario per completare con successo la tua richiesta!
Spanish: <color=#00ffff>¡Bienvenido a la página de contacto de los EMBAJADORES!</color> { Contacta con un embajador de cualquier facción y utiliza los sellos de credibilidad que ganes para mejorar tu posición. Por cada paso de <color=#ff7b00>hostil </color>a <color=#ffb875>no amistoso </color>y <color=#ffb875>no amistoso </color>a <color=#c0c0>neutral</color>, se consume un sello. Sin embargo, no puedes mejorar tu reputación con la facción más allá de la neutral con los sellos de credibilidad de la facción. Puedes ganar sellos completando misiones de credibilidad. Algunas misiones de historia y misiones (si están disponibles para esta facción) también los ofrecen.\nImportante: ¡Necesitas tener los sellos en tu inventario para completar con éxito tu solicitud!
Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#00ffff>Bem-vindo à página de contato do EMBAIXADOR!</color>\nEntre em contato com um embaixador de qualquer facção e use os selos de credibilidade que você ganhou para melhorar sua posição. Para cada passo de <color=#ff7b00>hostil</color> para <color=#ffb875>inamistoso</color> e <color=#ffb875>inamistoso</color> para <color=#c0c0c0>neutro</color>, um selo é consumido. No entanto, você não pode melhorar sua reputação com a facção além de neutro com os selos de credibilidade da facção. Você pode ganhar selos ao concluir missões de credibilidade. Algumas missões de história e missões (se disponíveis para essa facção) também os oferecem.\nIMPORTANTE: Você precisa ter os selos em seu inventário para concluir sua solicitação com êxito!
Russian: <color=#00ffff>Добро пожаловать на страницу контактов ПОСЛОВ!</color>\nСвяжитесь с послом любой фракции и используйте заработанные Печати репутации, чтобы улучшить свое положение. Для каждого шага от <color=#ff7b00>враждебного </color>до <color=#ffb875>недружелюбного </color>и <color=#ffb875>недружелюбного </color>до <color=#c0c0c0>нейтрального</color>, требуется одна печать. Однако вы не можете улучшить свою репутацию с фракцией за пределами нейтральной с помощью Печати репутации фракции. Вы можете заработать печати, выполняя миссии доверия. Некоторые сюжетные миссии и квесты (если они доступны для этой фракции) также предлагают их.\nВАЖНО: Для успешного выполнения запроса вам необходимо иметь печати в своем инвентаре!
Japanese: <color=#00ffff>大使への連絡のページにようこそ！</color>\n派閥の大使に連絡し, 獲得した信頼の印章を使用して地位を向上させましょう. <color=#ff7b00>敵対</color>から<color=#ffb875>嫌悪</color>, <color=#ffb875>嫌悪</color>から<color=#c0c0c0>中立へ</color>の各ステップで, 1つの印章が消費されます. ただし, 派閥の信頼の印章を使って中立を超えて派閥の評判を向上させることはできません. 信頼ミッションを完了すると, 印章を獲得できます.  いくつかのストーリーミッションとクエスト（この派閥で利用可能な場合）もそれらを提供します. \n重要：リクエストを正常に完了するには, インベントリに印章が入っている必要があります！
Chinese (simplified): <color=#00ffff>欢迎来到大使联系页面！</color>/n联系任何派别的大使，使用您赢得的信誉印章来提高您的地位。从<color=#ff7b00>敌对</color>到<color=#ffb875>不友好</color>，再从<color=#ffb875>不友好</color>到<color=#c0c0c0>中立</color>，每一步都会消耗一枚印章。不过，使用派系信誉印章无法将你在派系中的声望提高到中立以上。您可以通过完成信誉任务来获得印章。一些故事任务和任务（如果该派别有的话）也会提供印章！
Chinese (traditional): <color=#00ffff>歡迎來到派系大使聯絡頁面!</color>\n聯繫任一派系的大使並使用信任勳章來增加聲望度. 可從 <color=#ff7b00>敵對 </color>到 <color=#ffb875>不友善的 </color>跟 <color=#ffb875>不友善的  </color>到 <color=#c0c0c0>中立</color>, 會消耗一個信任勳章. 只不過, 你無法用信任勳章增加聲望度到超過中立的聲望. 你可以透過信任度任務來取得信任勳章. 有些故事任務和章節 (如果有關於該派系的話) 也會提供.\n重要: 你需要有信任勳章在你身上來完成申請!
Vietnamese: <color=#00ffff> Chào mừng đến với trang liên hệ AMBASSADOR! </color>\nLiên hệ với đại sứ của bất kỳ phe phái nào và sử dụng chứng nhận tín nhiệm kiếm được của bạn để cải thiện vị thế của bạn. Đối với mỗi nấc từ <color=#ff7b00> thù địch </color> đến <color=#ffb875> không thân thiện </color> và <color=#ffb875> không thân thiện </color> đến <color=#c0c0c0c0> trung lập, sẽ tiêu thụ một chứng nhận. Tuy nhiên, bạn không thể nâng cao danh tiếng của mình với phe đã trên trung lập bằng các chứng nhận tín nhiệm của phe. Bạn có thể kiếm được con dấu bằng cách hoàn thành các nhiệm vụ uy tín. Một số nhiệm vụ cốt truyện và nhiệm vụ (nếu có cho phe này) cũng trả chứng nhận.\nQUAN TRỌNG: Bạn cần có chứng nhận trong túi để hoàn thành thành công yêu cầu của mình!

Italiano:
Nota:
- Per ripristinare la condizione di Ostile a Neutrale, è necessario un sigillo di credibilità della fazione.

Spanish:
